name: KSH International Ltd
title: KSH International Ltd - 544664 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capacity-led growth: installed capacity 43,445 t rising to ~59,000 t, utilisation ~70% in Q4, EBITDA/ton ~INR 74,000 in Q4 and ~67,600 for FY26, with 65-70k guided as sustainable.

utilisation.quote: Consolidated company utilization was approximately 70% during Q4.

capex.peers_comment: Management said transformer OEMs are not backward integrating and that new CTC entrants may take five to seven years to qualify.
capex.quote: once Phase II of our Supa expansion is complete, we would have an installed capacity of roughly 59,000 metric tons.

triggers.label: Utilisation ~70% in Q4
triggers.quote: Consolidated company utilization was approximately 70% during Q4.

triggers.label: Capacity 43,445 t → ~59,000 t
triggers.quote: once Phase II of our Supa expansion is complete, we would have an installed capacity of roughly 59,000 metric tons.

triggers.label: EBITDA/ton ~INR 74,000 in Q4
triggers.quote: we reported an EBITDA per ton of approximately INR 74,000, up from roughly INR 64,500 in Q3 and 60,000 a year ago

triggers.label: Working capital days 65-68
triggers.quote: working capital days, calculated on average balances, which remain between 65 to 68 days in FY26

triggers.label: New CTC entrants 5-7 yrs to qualify
triggers.quote: new entrants have taken anywhere from five to seven years to finally come up to a 765kV range as well

guidance.value: INR 65,000-70,000 long term; 67,000-74,000 in another answer
guidance.quote: we feel a range of around 65,000 to 70,000 per metric ton will be sustainable on a long-term basis

guidance.value: at least last year's growth rate of ~21%
guidance.quote: at the very least we should be able to do last year's growth, which is 21%

guidance.value: above 25 days, close to 30 by year end
guidance.quote: the current year also are targeted to improve the payable days beyond 25 to close to 30 days by the end of the year

guidance.value: back to ~40% over next couple of years
guidance.quote: Our endeavor is to take it back up to about 40% over the next couple of years

prior_guidance_check.quote: For FY26, we delivered EBITDA per ton above our expected range of around 65,000 to 67,000 per metric ton.

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow negative on working capital build
red_flags.quote: the cash flows from operating activities, mainly because of the investments that are going into the receivables as well as inventory is negative in the current year

evasions.quote: That level of granularity is not something that we do provide.
